plan.connection: reuse exploratory center-x ring and original adjacency diagnostics; generated rings unconfirmed, complex source rings not reordered
plan.evaluation: save all constructed candidates before reading fixed original references; report BEV plus upper/lower continuous longitude differences where applicable, failures and unavailable metrics explicitly
